page.layout: One page of text inside an ornamental woodcut border; running head at top centre, page number at top right; a small marginal fragment at the far left edge belonging to the neighbouring page (not transcribed); a sidenote "Si" at the lower right inside the text block; a signature-like "H" centred near the foot of the text.

main_text.p: tos arte producere, aut ex verme bombycino papilionem elicere, aut lignam in lapidem beneficio aquarum lapidificativarum convertere, & quæ sunt id genus varia naturæ miranda. Nos nihil hîc contra ordinem naturæ tentandum esse, iterum atque iterum profitemur. Quòd si natura ipsa proprio suo motu metalla transmutat, ut ferrum in cuprum, ligna in lapides, ut notum est, &c. Quidni licebit etiam artificio, naturæ æmulo, corrumpere formam unius metalli, & per naturæ motum ac debita media, pretiosius ex viliori metallo producere? quâ de re postea.
Alterum argumentum ab exemplo est universale, idq; hujusmodi.

page.notes: The text is partly faint and show-through from the reverse is visible in the middle of the text block; the word "de" in "quâ de re" is partly obscured by a smudge and is uncertain. The sidenote "Si" at lower right is the start of a marginal note, which is incomplete on this scan. The left margin fragment belongs to the previous page and is not transcribed. The first line is a continuation fragment of a sentence from the previous page.
